name: jev
title: Jev
description: Run saved checks, file documents into configured folders, and search browser bookmarks with TypeSafe Jev.
author: Olli0103

commands.name: run-preset
commands.title: Run Preset
commands.description: Check or categorize selected text with a saved preset.

commands.name: file-documents
commands.title: File Documents
commands.description: Review and move selected documents into configured folders, with undo.

commands.name: search-links
commands.title: Search Links
commands.description: Search selected browser bookmarks by words or meaning.

commands.name: manage-presets
commands.title: Manage Presets
commands.description: Create, edit, duplicate, and export your text checks and categories.

commands.name: filing-history
commands.title: Filing History
commands.description: Inspect document moves and safely undo them.

commands.name: backup-restore
commands.title: Backup and Restore
commands.description: Export Jev settings and links, or recover a previous version.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: TypeSafe API Key
preferences.description: Get a key at console.typesafe.ai. Used only for explicit Jev requests. Manual filing and keyword bookmark search work without it.

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint
